notes: Synthetic PASS: whistle motif echoes and transforms.
text:
EXT. SCHOOLYARD - DAY

A tin WHISTLE hangs from NOAH's neck. He blows once. Kids freeze. He blows twice. They run.

NOAH
Again. On two you vanish.

SASHA
Coach, if I vanish on two, who gets the ball?

NOAH
Whoever kept listening on one.

Later, in the empty yard, Noah finds the whistle in the dirt, mud in the mouthpiece. He does not blow it. He hangs it on the fence where Sasha will see it and choose.
